messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - embeddings-api-us-west2 - error rate spike (5xx) - auto-page fired -> https://pagerduty.example/PD12345
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 triggered, escalation started. Noted as HIGH.
oncall-julia: ACK - taking this. I’m on the page and looking at dashboards now.
sam-sre: seeing a sharp uptick in 502/504s from edge -> inference-proxy -> embeddings service, 2xx dropping from 99.9% to ~86% in last 3m.
max-eng: logs show repeated upstream timeouts and kvcache misses around the same time. sample: `curl -v https://embeddings-usw2.prod/health` -> 502 
carla-cs: any customer-facing errors? Support flagging 3 paying customers with elevated error rates. Listing contacts now.
tiffany-pm: ETA on impact window? need to prep comms if this stays >10m.
oncall-julia: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale embeddings pool + add warm nodes 2) route non-critical traffic to quantized-fallback model 3) enable short-term ingress rate-limit for noisy clients. Doing 1 now.
sam-sre: scaling initiated -> GPU pool +6 nodes (requested). Also bumping connection timeouts at proxy from 15s -> 30s while we stabilize.
max-eng: applying fallback route rule (route weight: primary 60% / fallback 40%) to drain pressure. Pushing now.
carla-cs: affected customers: Acme Analytics, BrightRetail, NoteDocs. Acme seeing 40% failures; CS on standby to open tickets.
tiffany-pm: please add a status line in status.redwood.ai and mention degraded embeddings in us-west2 with some customers affected.
oncall-julia: enabled ingress rate-limit for top noisy tokens (temporary). Observability: 5xx rate returning toward baseline, now at ~10% -> continuing to monitor.
sam-sre: cache warmup in progress; rehydrating kv caches on new nodes. This should cut some downstream retries.
pagerduty: PD escalation: sent to senior-oncall for visibility. No manual escalation yet.
max-eng: small config tweak: reduced keepalive on proxy -> 10s; should free connections for healthy requests.
carla-cs: opened support tickets and notified Acme/BR/NoteDocs with interim mitigation steps. All acknowledged.
tiffany-pm: draft status update posted to internal comms channel. Will wait for stable signal before public update.
oncall-julia: 5xx now ~1.3% over last 2m. Rolling back rate-limit + keeping fallback route for 5 more minutes. Please confirm no regressions.
sam-sre: no new 502 spikes in logs; tailing error logs for 10m.
max-eng: removing fallback route in 2m, leaving autoscale policies to normalize.
oncall-julia: handing off to next oncall (sam-sre) for monitoring for 30m, then will close PD if stable.
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by oncall-julia, status: investigating -> monitoring.
sam-sre: taking monitoring handoff. Marking timeline in incident doc.
incident-bot: PD12345 status updated -> monitoring.
carla-cs: customer check-ins queued; no escalations requested.
tiffany-pm: thanks all. Postmortem owner: sam-sre. Please capture root cause and mitigation timeline.
oncall-julia: resolved for now from my side. If error rate creeps, reopen. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PD12345 resolved -> auto-close scheduled in 1h unless re-opened.
